answer_1.quote: This paper presented CaLF, a fine-tuning method for LLMs to produce accurate citations alongside generated text.

answer_2.quote: We follow the official metrics and nomenclature of  to measure correctness (via EM Recall), fluency (via MAUVE ), and citation F 1 (via an NLI-trained T5-11B model ).

answer_4.quote: Human subjects are tasked to judge the models' generations regarding: (i) citation recall: judgement whether a generated sentence is fully supported by citations, (ii) citation precision: whether a citation partially or fully supports a sentence, (iii) informativeness: whether the generation helps to answer the question, (iv) coherence: whether generated sentences are semantically and syntactically well-connected, (v) fluency: whether all sentences are grammatically correct and well-readable.
answer_4.guideline: judgement whether a generated sentence is fully supported by citations, whether a citation partially or fully supports a sentence, whether the generation helps to answer the question, whether generated sentences are semantically and syntactically well-connected, whether all sentences are grammatically correct and well-readable.
